probe.name: V2_count_star
probe.sql:
SELECT ts_aggr.timestamp,
       sum(bs_per_bldg.tract_count) AS metadata_rows_count,
       count(*) AS model_count,
       sum(bs_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS units_count,
       sum(ts_aggr.bs_elec * bs_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS elec
FROM (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
         ts.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
         sum(ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption") AS bs_elec
  FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_by_state_vu AS ts
  WHERE ts.upgrade IN (0) AND ts.state = 'CO'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
) AS ts_aggr
JOIN (
  SELECT bs.bldg_id AS bldg_id,
         sum(bs.weight) AS bldg_weight,
         count(*) AS tract_count
  FROM resstock_2024_amy2018_release_2_metadata AS bs
  WHERE bs.upgrade = 0 AND bs."in.state" = 'CO'
  GROUP BY bs.bldg_id
) AS bs_per_bldg ON bs_per_bldg.bldg_id = ts_aggr.bldg_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
